_comment: Published list prices for each lab's own models, US dollars per million tokens. This is the price a serving
scenario earns on frontier tokens under the 'list' price basis: the lab sells its own models at its own list price.
(The default 'effective' basis uses OpenRouter's traffic-weighted effective price for the same models instead.)
Every run of update.py re-reads these and APPLIES any change (the move is logged in update.log as well):
OpenAI rows ('confirm': 'openai_page'): OpenAI's own API pricing page, developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing,
Standard tab (short context): input, cached input, cache writes, output. OpenRouter's OpenAI rows are not used
for these: on 2026-10-14 the row OpenRouter labels standard for GPT-5.6 Sol showed $2/$10, which is OpenAI's
Flex / Batch price, against $4/$20 on OpenAI's Standard tab.
Anthropic rows ('confirm': 'openrouter'): OpenRouter's public endpoint feed, where the 'Anthropic' provider row
carries the Anthropic pricing page's list price.
A row set to 'confirm': 'manual' is never overwritten. A read that moves a price more than 3x is kept and logged
